transcript.text:
Thank you all for raising these important points. Let me address each one before we proceed.

First, Marcus — thank you for flagging the Rina-Jonah relationship. That's exactly the kind of conflict-of-interest concern I needed to hear before finalizing the panel. Given that Rina has been informally coaching Jonah for the past year, it would be inappropriate for her to serve on a panel evaluating him. I'll exclude Rina from consideration.

Second, Priya — I appreciate you surfacing the four firsthand observations of Mara's coaching. That evidence needs to be formally documented before it can be considered in the assessment. I'll need those observations entered into the formal leadership-evidence record before the panel evaluates either candidate, so we have a complete and consistent evidence base.

Third, Sofia — thank you for identifying the process gap. Standardized questions and individual written score sheets are clearly required by our internal-selection procedure. I'll make sure both requirements are explicitly added to the selection packet before any interviews take place.

Fourth, Tariq — thank you for raising Mara's accessibility need on her behalf. Per our accessibility practice, once a candidate states a need through the employee representative, it must be implemented. Mara will receive the interview questions at least 48 hours in advance and will be allowed to submit written responses. I want to be clear that this is about equivalent opportunity to demonstrate the leadership criteria — the panel will evaluate both candidates against the same criteria, even though the interview format will differ for Mara.

Now, regarding panel composition: with Rina excluded due to the conflict of interest, the three panelists will be Elliot, Sofia, and Tariq. I'd like to confirm with everyone — does anyone see any additional conflicts or process concerns with this panel before I finalize the decision and record all of these considerations in the selection log?
